text: Ola Electric has commenced phase 2 expansion at its Pochampalli FutureFactory in Krishnagiri district with an investment commitment of ₹2,400 crore, creating over 2,100 jobs for skilled technician and assembly line workers.
Siemens Gamesa in partnership with renewable developer ACME has broken ground on a ₹1,800 crore turbine component and green hydrogen equipment manufacturing unit in Tuticorin SIPCOT Phase-2.
IFS Logistics has commissioned its 150-acre integrated agro-processing and cold chain terminal in Krishnagiri with an initial capital outlay of ₹350 crore.
Ather Energy announces recruitment drive for 800 battery pack technicians across Hosur manufacturing facility.
ACME Cleantech commences civil works on ₹5,200 crore green hydrogen and ammonia plant in VOC Port industrial zone, Thoothukudi.
Stock market indices closed marginally higher on Monday as banking and financial shares witnessed buying interest across Mumbai and Delhi exchanges.
Celebrity cricketer visits Chennai mall for commercial endorsement and autograph signing event.
Weather forecast predicts moderate to heavy monsoon rainfall across coastal Tamil Nadu districts over the next 48 hours.
